text: I usually wake up at six-thirty, and my first habit is to drink a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower and a light breakfast, I leave for work by eight. My job as a graphic designer keeps me busy until five, but I always take a short lunch break to walk outside. In the evening, I exercise for about thirty minutes—either jogging or doing yoga. Then I cook dinner, read a book, and spend some time relaxing with my family. I try to follow this routine every day because consistency helps me feel organized and less stressed.
